top_signals.title: Forward Air pauses sale of intermodal unit
top_signals.summary:
Forward Air revealed it has halted a planned sale of its intermodal segment; however, with operations returning to target performance, the company remains open to offers that align with its fair market value.

The post Forward Air pauses sale of intermodal unit appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Coinbase, Kalshi and Payward backs CFTC in lawsuit over single-stock perp futures
top_signals.summary: The crypto firms moved for leave to file an amicus brief defending the CFTC's authority to regulate single-stock perpetual futures in the US.
